content: Although Liverpool must approve the transfer of Uruguayan forward Darwin Nunez, 26, to enable a deal, they are prepared to begin discussions regarding a move for Eintracht Frankfurt’s 23-year-old French striker Hugo Ekitike.

["Liverpool are ready to open talks over a move for Eintracht Frankfurt's French striker Hugo Ekitike, 23, even though the club need to sanction the transfer of Uruguay forward Darwin Nunez, 26, in order to facilitate a deal."]
